column1: # Tatar compound-word admission review. Words are NFC lowercase with U+002D only.
# frequency is the summed exact written-form count of every case variant in the

# read. proper_display is the approved display form of a proper compound, empty
# for an ordinary word; a capitalized variant that is only a sentence start keeps
# the lowercase key and no display form.
